description: Grammar curriculum areas assessed under Grammatical Range & Accuracy, and the error subtypes that the Writing/Speaking graders must use when tagging grammar errors. Every grammar error subtype maps to exactly one area; the Grammar module groups the error log by these subtypes.

areas.name: Tense and aspect
areas.focus: Present perfect vs past simple, future forms, tense consistency in Task 1 descriptions of past data and forecasts.

areas.name: Subject–verb agreement and articles
areas.focus: a/an/the/zero article (the highest-frequency error for many candidates) and agreement with collective nouns, 'the number of' vs 'a number of', long subjects.

areas.name: Complex sentences
areas.focus: Defining and non-defining relative clauses, subordinate (adverbial) clauses, noun clauses.

areas.name: Conditionals and hypothetical language
areas.focus: Zero/first/second/third and mixed conditionals; wish, if only, it's time, supposing — for Part 3 and opinion essays.

areas.name: Passive voice
areas.focus: Passive forms across tenses, especially for Task 1 process diagrams; choosing active vs passive; impersonal passives (it is believed that…).

areas.name: Modals and hedging
areas.focus: would, could, might, may, tend to, is likely to, appears to — academic caution and speculation.

areas.name: Comparatives, superlatives and language of change
areas.focus: rose sharply, a gradual decline, plateaued, peaked at, twice as many as, the largest proportion — Task 1 data language.

areas.name: Cohesive devices and linking words
areas.focus: Correct meaning and punctuation of linkers, referencing, and avoiding mechanical over-use (a common band-6 trap).

areas.name: Reported speech, inversion and cleft sentences
areas.focus: Band-8 structures: reported speech, negative/conditional inversion, it-clefts and wh-clefts, fronting, participle clauses.

areas.name: Prepositions and phrasal verbs
areas.focus: Prepositions of time/place/change (by, to, from, at, of), dependent prepositions (responsible for, impact on), phrasal verbs.

areas.name: Punctuation and sentence boundaries
areas.focus: Comma splices, run-on sentences, fragments, commas after introductory clauses and around non-defining clauses, apostrophes, capitals.

areas.name: Countable/uncountable nouns and quantifiers
areas.focus: information/advice/research/equipment, much vs many, fewer vs less, a large number/amount of, plural forms.

areas.name: Word formation
areas.focus: Noun/verb/adjective/adverb families (economy, economic, economical, economically), -ing/-ed adjectives, negative prefixes.
